_comment: E11.7-11: the copy-paste message templates in the partner asset kit. Each body holds {link} and {code} exactly once; the dashboard fills them with the partner's own /r/{CODE} link and code. Partner copy rules: sentence case, no exclamation marks, none of the brief's banned words, no reward figure or date (those come from configuration), and every template says that the partner earns commission.

Hi, I've joined Valstara's partner programme. Valstara is a direct seller of digital goods backed by the Triple Guarantee. If you join the waitlist through my link and confirm your email, you get early access and a welcome discount on your first order: {link}

You can also enter my code, {code}, under "Have a referral code?" on the signup form. I may earn a commission on what you buy.
